_design: Card pin (Boss 2026-11-26): the player taps a card, then the ground; the card walks there and stays. PLACEHOLDER numbers (combat-designer 2026-11-26) until the Boss plays.
_pin_radius: Metres around the pin a pinned card may step inside (to reach a melee enemy). It never chases outside.
_arrive: With nothing in reach, a card further than this from the pin walks back to its centre.
_run_distance: Runs (spends stamina) to the pin when further than this.
_edge_margin: A pin is clamped this far inside the arena edges (a body's half width).
